sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was lowered: Q1 2026 transaction revenue guided to about $420M through 10 February, and subscription and services guided down to $550M to $630M on lower crypto prices, rates and rewards. The GAAP net loss of $667M was driven by unrealized crypto losses, and crypto market cap fell 11% in the quarter. Against this, expenses were held flat and full-year volume and share doubled, but the lowered forward guide and cautious language on the outlook push the score slightly negative.

summary.revenue: Q4 revenue $1.8B, down 5% quarter over quarter. Full-year 2025 revenue $7.2B, up 9%.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 transaction revenue about $420M through 10 February amid heightened volatility. Q1 subscription and services guided down to $550M to $630M on lower crypto prices, rates and rewards. Expenses held flat quarter over quarter.
key_risks: Crypto market cap fell 11% in the quarter and the softness is reflected in the subscription guide.
Brief platform interruptions affected core buy, sell and transfer functions.
A $718M unrealized loss on the crypto portfolio plus $395M on strategic investments including Circle.
key_opportunities: Global trading volume and market share both doubled year over year to all-time highs.
We store 12% of all crypto in the world, more than the next four competitors combined.
Q4 marked our ninth consecutive quarter of native unit inflows.

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management highlights record volume and market share (positive) but also guides subscription revenue lower and acknowledges a GAAP loss and platform interruptions (cautious/defensive).
